verses.1: He is my shepherd; I will not be ashamed.
verses.2: He made me lie down in green pastures; he led me beside still waters.
verses.3: Restore my spirit; lead me in the right paths for your name's sake.
verses.4: For though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff comfort me.
verses.5: You pour water in front of me, in front of my staff, you pour water over my head, and my cup runs out.
verses.6: Nevertheless, goodness and loving - kindness will follow me as long as I live, and I will spend many days in your house.
